collection.credit:
ISOLA — BEYOND THE HORIZON: THE WORLD WE IMAGINE
A NEW, SEPARATE COMPANION EVENT ANTHOLOGY FOR VIRTUAL VILLAGERS 1–5
Version 1.0 | 40 original branching events
collection.description: An elder asks whether people beyond the sea might look every imaginable way, or resemble Isolans closely.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: An elder asks whether people beyond the sea might have every imaginable combination of hair, skin, facial features, and body shapes - or resemble Isolans closely.

choices.label: Ask what matters in meeting someone.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: A child imagines meeting someone who looks like a long-lost cousin and laughs at the coincidence.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A scholar notes that similar appearance would not prove shared customs or ancestry.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: An artist sketches many respectful variations of ordinary human appearance.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The artist realizes that drawings cannot capture an entire person's character.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The group decides to begin with names, intentions, and courtesy rather than assumptions.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: An elder says appearance can be part of identity and culture too; respect means neither erasing nor stereotyping it.
